units.translation: 606 ⟦1⟧ 901, ⟦2⟧ and often: so you must pay for your murder with death, as she paid for hers; as long as you live, we pursue you. ⟦3⟧ (M) like ⟦4⟧ ⟦5⟧, but the sense requires the dative (Schütz).
606 ⟦1⟧ within the blood relationship, as one says ⟦2⟧ (⟦3⟧). — 607

⟦1⟧: namely, if not with her blood (Weil); this sense, however, only emerges with ⟦2⟧ (⟦3⟧ ⟦4⟧, "who else"). On ⟦5⟧ cf. ⟦6⟧; ⟦7⟧ strong for ⟦8⟧ (Schol.). With this the accusation closes emphatically. 609—613 Orestes. The defense begins also without a special granting of the floor, since there had already been dialogue: Orestes calls upon Apollo to give testimony (594) that he had ordered the deed, and then to instruct about the right of the deed, which is a position more worthy of this god than that of a ⟦9⟧. ⟦10⟧ singular as at 234.—611
for how did she nourish you
for who would have stopped the diseases of Hera
not to have the city suffer as it does
